summary: Initializes a physics inertia-tensor parameter object on `this`: allocates and copies the name string a2 into this+0x0, stores the scalar value a3 and its reciprocal at this+0xAC and this+0xB4, copies a 3-component inertia vector from a4 into this+0xBC through this+0xCC, stores the per-component reciprocals at this+0xD4, this+0xDC and this+0xE4, then delegates to InertiaTensorWorldSpaceTransform to finish the setup.

operations.description: Allocate a name buffer of strlen(a2) + 1 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper.
Store the allocated name pointer at this+0x0.
Copy the input name string a2 into the allocated buffer (strcpy).
Store the scalar value a3 (mass or moment) as a double at this+0xAC.
Store the reciprocal 1.0 / a3 at this+0xB4; the 1.0 constant comes from dbl_59E420.
Copy 24 bytes (0x18) of a4 into this+0xBC, populating the 3-component inertia vector at this+0xBC, this+0xC4 and this+0xCC.
Store the reciprocal 1.0 / this+0xBC at this+0xD4.
Store the reciprocal 1.0 / this+0xC4 at this+0xDC.
Store the reciprocal 1.0 / this+0xCC at this+0xE4.
Call InertiaTensorWorldSpaceTransform(this) to compute the world-space transform of the inertia tensor.
